rules.text: A change to heading 2401 from any other chapter.

A change to heading 2402 from any other chapter or from wrapper tobacco not threshed or similarly processed of heading 2401, or from homogenized or reconstituted tobacco suitable for use as wrapper tobacco of heading 2403.

(A) A change to homogenized or reconstituted tobacco for use as cigar wrapper of subheading 2403.91 from any other heading; or
(B) A change to any other good of heading 2403 from any other chapter.
